# =============================================================================
# Authentik LXC - Identity Provider (SSO/OIDC)
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 203
#
# Replaces Authelia with a more feature-rich identity provider:
#   - Native Google/GitHub OAuth federation
#   - OIDC provider for apps with native SSO support
#   - Forward auth for apps without native OAuth
#   - Centralized user/group management
#
# Uses the docker-lxc module - the gold standard pattern for Docker apps.
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  description = "Container ID for Authentik LXC"
  type        = number
  default     = 203
}

variable "cores" {
  description = "CPU cores"
  type        = number
  default     = 2
}

variable "memory" {
  description = "Memory in MB"
  type        = number
  default     = 4096  # Authentik recommended minimum
}

variable "swap" {
  description = "Swap in MB"
  type        = number
  default     = 1024
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  description = "Root filesystem size in GB"
  type        = number
  default     = 16
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Authentik Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "authentik" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  name         = "authentik"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network (container network only - Traefik handles external access)
  container_ip = "${local.ip_registry.dashboards.authentik}${local.network.container_netmask}"

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = var.swap

  rootfs_storage = "nvme-containers"
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # Unprivileged container (security hardened)
  unprivileged = true

  # Deployment
  deploy_dir  = "${path.module}/deploy"
  target_path = "/config"

  # Exclude .env template files (we generate .env from template)
  exclude_patterns = ["^\\.env"]

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  proxmox_ssh_host     = var.proxmox_ssh_host

  # Template with Docker pre-installed
  template = var.lxc_template_docker

  # Proxmox Notes
  service_name        = "Authentik"
  service_description = "Identity Provider - SSO, OIDC, and forward auth for all homelab services"

  service_urls = {
    admin    = "https://auth.${var.domain_internal}/if/admin/"
    user     = "https://auth.${var.domain_internal}/if/user/"
    direct   = "http://${local.ip_registry.dashboards.authentik}:9000"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "Authentik HTTP", port = 9000, info = "Web UI and API" },
    { name = "Authentik HTTPS", port = 9443, info = "HTTPS (self-signed)" },
    { name = "PostgreSQL", port = 5432, info = "Database (internal only)" }
  ]

  custom_notes = <<-EOT
## Initial Setup

1. Access the admin interface at https://auth.${var.domain_internal}/if/admin/
2. Login with credentials from 1Password (item: authentik)
3. Configure Google OAuth source for SSO

## Forward Auth Endpoint

Add this middleware to Traefik routes for protected services:
```yaml
middlewares:
  authentik:
    forwardAuth:
      address: http://${local.ip_registry.dashboards.authentik}:9000/outpost.goauthentik.io/auth/traefik
      trustForwardHeader: true
      authResponseHeaders:
        - X-authentik-username
        - X-authentik-groups
        - X-authentik-email
        - X-authentik-name
        - X-authentik-uid
        - X-authentik-jwt
        - X-authentik-meta-jwks
        - X-authentik-meta-outpost
        - X-authentik-meta-provider
        - X-authentik-meta-app
        - X-authentik-meta-version
```

## Quick Commands

```bash
# View server logs
docker logs -f authentik-server

# View worker logs
docker logs -f authentik-worker

# Database backup
docker exec authentik-postgres pg_dump -U authentik authentik > backup.sql

# Restart services
cd /config && docker compose restart
```

## OIDC Configuration

For apps with native OIDC support, create a Provider in Authentik:
1. Admin → Providers → Create OAuth2/OIDC Provider
2. Set redirect URI for the app
3. Create Application linking to the provider
4. Use client_id and client_secret in the app config

## Managed by OpenTofu

Run `task tofu:apply APP=authentik` to update.
EOT

  tags = ["authentik", "auth", "sso", "oidc", "identity"]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Create .env file with secrets
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Generate .env file locally with secrets from 1Password, then sync to container

resource "local_sensitive_file" "authentik_env" {
  content = templatefile("${path.module}/deploy/.env.tpl", {
    postgres_password = local.op.authentik_postgres_password
    secret_key        = local.op.authentik_secret_key
    admin_email       = "admin@${var.domain_internal}"
    admin_password    = local.op.authentik_admin_password
  })
  filename        = "${path.module}/.terraform/authentik.env"
  file_permission = "0600"
}

resource "filesync_file" "authentik_env" {
  source      = local_sensitive_file.authentik_env.filename
  destination = "/config/.env"
  host        = module.authentik.ip_address

  mode = "0600"

  depends_on = [module.authentik]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Traefik Route - Self-Service Route Registration
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "authentik_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "authentik"
  backend_url = "http://${module.authentik.ip_address}:9000"

  # Internal route (HTTPS via Let's Encrypt)
  # Using "auth" subdomain to match Authelia for easier migration
  internal_domain = "auth.${var.domain_internal}"

  # Public route for external access (Google OAuth redirect)
  public_domain = "auth.${var.domain_public}"

  # Traefik config
  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # No auth middleware on the auth service itself!
  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers"]
  public_middlewares   = ["security-headers"]

  depends_on = [module.authentik]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Traefik Forward Auth Middleware
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Generates the forwardAuth middleware config and syncs to Traefik

resource "local_file" "traefik_middleware" {
  content = templatefile("${path.module}/deploy/traefik-middleware.yml.tpl", {
    authentik_ip = module.authentik.ip_address
  })
  filename = "${path.module}/.terraform/authentik-middleware.yml"
}

resource "filesync_file" "traefik_middleware" {
  source      = local_file.traefik_middleware.filename
  destination = "/config/dynamic/authentik-middleware.yml"
  host        = local.traefik_ip

  mode = "0644"

  depends_on = [module.authentik, local_file.traefik_middleware]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Google OAuth Source - SSO via Google Account
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Allows users to login with their Google account
# Credentials stored in 1Password (authentik item)

data "authentik_flow" "default_source_authentication" {
  slug = "default-source-authentication"
}

data "authentik_flow" "default_source_enrollment" {
  slug = "default-source-enrollment"
}

resource "authentik_source_oauth" "google" {
  name                = "Google"
  slug                = "google"
  authentication_flow = data.authentik_flow.default_source_authentication.id
  enrollment_flow     = data.authentik_flow.default_source_enrollment.id

  provider_type   = "google"
  consumer_key    = local.op.authentik_google_client_id
  consumer_secret = local.op.authentik_google_client_secret

  # Allow users to link existing accounts
  user_matching_mode = "identifier"

  # Policy engine mode
  policy_engine_mode = "any"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Backup Configuration - PBS Client + Sidecars
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "authentik_sidecars" {
  source = "../../modules/lxc-sidecars"

  container_id   = module.authentik.container_id
  container_ip   = module.authentik.ip_address
  container_name = "authentik"

  proxmox_ssh_host             = var.proxmox_ssh_host
  proxmox_ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  backup = {
    enabled   = true
    schedule  = "Sun 03:00"  # Weekly backup
    retention = "4"          # Keep 4 weekly backups
    namespace = "lxc-203"

    # Dump PostgreSQL before backup
    pre_backup_commands = [
      {
        name    = "Backup PostgreSQL database"
        command = "docker exec authentik-postgres pg_dump -U authentik authentik > /config/authentik-db-backup.sql"
        timeout = 120
      }
    ]

    include_paths = ["/config"]
    exclude_paths = ["/var/lib/docker/overlay2"]

    ntfy_priority = "default"
    ntfy_tags     = "backup,authentik"
  }

  # Container monitoring agents
  pulse_agent = {
    enabled     = true
    pulse_token = local.agent_tokens["authentik"].pulse_token
  }

  arcane_agent = {
    enabled         = true
    bootstrap_token = local.agent_tokens["authentik"].arcane_bootstrap_token
  }

  alloy_agent = {
    enabled  = true
    username = local.op.alloy_telemetry_username
    password = local.op.alloy_telemetry_password
  }

  depends_on = [module.authentik]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Outputs
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

output "container_id" {
  value = module.authentik.container_id
}

output "ip_address" {
  value = module.authentik.ip_address
}

output "ssh_command" {
  value = module.authentik.ssh_command
}

output "urls" {
  value = {
    admin  = "https://auth.${var.domain_internal}/if/admin/"
    user   = "https://auth.${var.domain_internal}/if/user/"
    direct = "http://${module.authentik.ip_address}:9000"
  }
}

output "traefik_config_path" {
  description = "Path to Traefik config on Traefik LXC"
  value       = module.authentik_route.remote_config_path
}

output "forward_auth_url" {
  description = "URL for Traefik forwardAuth middleware"
  value       = "http://${module.authentik.ip_address}:9000/outpost.goauthentik.io/auth/traefik"
}

# Homelab Infrastructure Automation
# https://taskfile.dev

version: '3'

vars:
  PROJECT_ROOT: "{{.TASKFILE_DIR}}"
  TOFU_DIR: "{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/tofu"

env:
  # State encryption passphrase - MUST be TF_VAR because encryption runs before providers
  # All other secrets are now fetched via 1Password provider directly in OpenTofu
  TF_VAR_state_encryption_passphrase:
    sh: |
      if [ -n "$TF_VAR_state_encryption_passphrase" ]; then
        echo "$TF_VAR_state_encryption_passphrase"
      else
        op read "op://homelab/opentofu/password" 2>/dev/null || echo ""
      fi

# =============================================================================
# Included Taskfiles (flattened into main namespace)
# =============================================================================
includes:
  tofu:
    taskfile: ./tasks/tofu.yml
    flatten: true
    vars:
      PROJECT_ROOT: "{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}"
  backup:
    taskfile: ./tasks/backup.yml
    flatten: true
    vars:
      PROJECT_ROOT: "{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}"
  cloud:
    taskfile: ./tasks/cloud.yml
    flatten: true
    vars:
      PROJECT_ROOT: "{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}"
  template:
    taskfile: ./tasks/template.yml
    flatten: true
    vars:
      PROJECT_ROOT: "{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}"
  pbs:
    taskfile: ./tasks/pbs.yml
    flatten: true
    vars:
      PROJECT_ROOT: "{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}"
  importer:
    taskfile: ./tasks/immich-importer.yml
    vars:
      PROJECT_ROOT: "{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}"
  beads:
    taskfile: ./tasks/beads.yml
    flatten: true
    vars:
      PROJECT_ROOT: "{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}"

tasks:
  # ===========================================================================
  # Desktop LXC (Temporary GUI for Downloads)
  # ===========================================================================

  desktop:create:
    desc: "Create temporary GUI desktop LXC for downloading Google Takeout"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/desktop-lxc/create.sh

  desktop:destroy:
    desc: "Destroy temporary GUI desktop LXC"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/desktop-lxc/destroy.sh

  desktop:info:
    desc: "Show VNC connection info for desktop LXC"
    cmds:
      - |
        IP=$(ssh root@homelab "pct exec 600 -- ip -4 addr show eth0 | grep inet | awk '{print \$2}' | cut -d/ -f1" 2>/dev/null)
        if [ -z "$IP" ]; then
          echo "Desktop LXC (600) is not running or does not exist."
          echo "Run 'task desktop:create' first."
          exit 1
        fi
        echo "=== Desktop LXC VNC Connection ==="
        echo ""
        echo "VNC Host: $IP:5901"
        echo ""
        echo "macOS: Open Finder, Cmd+K, enter vnc://$IP:5901"
        echo ""
        echo "Downloads save to: /downloads (mounted to /tank/photo-import)"

  desktop:restart-vnc:
    desc: "Restart VNC server on desktop LXC"
    cmds:
      - |
        echo "Restarting VNC server..."
        ssh root@homelab "pct exec 600 -- bash -c 'vncserver -kill :1 2>/dev/null || true; vncserver :1 -geometry 1920x1080 -depth 24 -localhost no'"
        echo "VNC server restarted on display :1"

    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu init
    requires:
      vars: [APP]

  tofu:plan:
    desc: "Plan infrastructure changes for an app"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - pwd
      - tofu plan -out=tfplan
    requires:
      vars: [APP]
    preconditions:
      - sh: test -d .terraform
        msg: "Run 'task tofu:init APP={{.APP}}' first"

  tofu:apply:
    desc: "Apply planned infrastructure changes for an app (optional: REPLACE='resource.name')"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu apply {{if .REPLACE}}-replace='{{.REPLACE}}' -auto-approve{{else}}tfplan{{end}}
    requires:
      vars: [APP]
    preconditions:
      - sh: '{{if .REPLACE}}true{{else}}test -f tfplan{{end}}'
        msg: "Run 'task tofu:plan APP={{.APP}}' first"

  tofu:destroy:
    desc: "Destroy an app's infrastructure"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - echo "⚠️  This will destroy {{.APP}} infrastructure!"
      - tofu destroy
    requires:
      vars: [APP]
    prompt: "Are you sure you want to destroy {{.APP}}?"

  tofu:output:
    desc: "Show infrastructure outputs for an app"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu output
    requires:
      vars: [APP]

  tofu:state:
    desc: "List all resources in an app's state"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu state list
    requires:
      vars: [APP]

  tofu:state:rm:
    desc: "Remove a resource from state (APP, RESOURCE)"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu state rm '{{.RESOURCE}}'
    requires:
      vars: [APP, RESOURCE]

  tofu:import:
    desc: "Import existing resource into state (APP, ADDR, ID)"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu import '{{.ADDR}}' '{{.ID}}'
    requires:
      vars: [APP, ADDR, ID]

  tofu:show:
    desc: "Show saved plan details for an app"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu show tfplan
    requires:
      vars: [APP]
    preconditions:
      - sh: test -f tfplan
        msg: "Run 'task tofu:plan APP={{.APP}}' first"

  tofu:fmt:
    desc: "Format all Terraform files"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu fmt -recursive

  tofu:validate:
    desc: "Validate an app's configuration"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu validate
    requires:
      vars: [APP]

  tofu:encryption:setup:
    desc: "Set up state encryption passphrase in 1Password"
    cmds:
      - |
        echo "Creating 1Password item for state encryption..."
        PASSPHRASE=$(openssl rand -base64 32)
        op item create \
          --category=password \
          --title="opentofu" \
          --vault="homelab" \
          "password=$PASSPHRASE" \
          "notes=OpenTofu state encryption passphrase for homelab IaC"
        echo "✅ Created 1Password item 'opentofu'"
        echo "The passphrase will be automatically retrieved when running tofu commands"

  tofu:encryption:test:
    desc: "Test state encryption passphrase retrieval"
    cmds:
      - |
        if [ -n "$TF_VAR_state_encryption_passphrase" ]; then
          echo "✅ State encryption passphrase is set (${#TF_VAR_state_encryption_passphrase} chars)"
        else
          echo "❌ State encryption passphrase not set"
          echo "Run 'task tofu:encryption:setup' or set TF_VAR_state_encryption_passphrase"
          exit 1
        fi

  tofu:ssh:
    desc: "SSH to a deployed LXC by app name"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/tofu/ssh.sh {{.APP}}
    requires:
      vars: [APP]

  tofu:logs:
    desc: "View Docker logs from a deployed app"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/tofu/logs.sh {{.APP}} {{.SERVICE}}
    requires:
      vars: [APP, SERVICE]

  tofu:info:
    desc: "Show OpenTofu IaC status"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/tofu/info.sh

  # ===========================================================================
  # Batch Operations (all apps)
  # ===========================================================================

  tofu:plan:all:
    desc: "Run tofu plan for all apps"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/tofu-all.sh plan

  tofu:apply:all:
    desc: "Run tofu apply for all apps"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/tofu-all.sh apply

  tofu:status:
    desc: "Show recent tofu batch operation logs"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/tofu-all.sh status

# =============================================================================
# Cloudflare Tunnel Module
# =============================================================================
# Creates a Cloudflare tunnel DNS record to expose an internal service publicly.
# Works in conjunction with traefik-route module for complete public exposure.
#
# Flow:
# 1. App -> Traefik (internal)
# 2. Traefik public route (web entrypoint, no TLS)
# 3. Cloudflare tunnel -> Traefik
# 4. Cloudflare adds TLS
# 5. Public internet -> service
#
# Usage:
#   module "n8n_tunnel" {
#     source = "../../modules/cloudflare-tunnel"
#
#     hostname        = "n8n"
#     domain          = "rambtech.dev"
#     backend_url     = "http://192.168.1.162"  # Traefik
#     tunnel_id       = var.cloudflare_tunnel_id
#     cloudflare_account_id = var.cloudflare_account_id
#   }
# =============================================================================

terraform {
  required_providers {
    cloudflare = {
      source = "cloudflare/cloudflare"
    }
  }
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Cloudflare Tunnel DNS Record
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Get the zone ID for the domain
data "cloudflare_zone" "domain" {
  name = var.domain
}

# Create CNAME record pointing to the tunnel
resource "cloudflare_record" "tunnel_dns" {
  zone_id = data.cloudflare_zone.domain.id
  name    = var.hostname
  value   = "${var.tunnel_id}.cfargotunnel.com"
  type    = "CNAME"
  proxied = true  # Enable Cloudflare proxy (orange cloud)
  ttl     = 1     # Auto TTL when proxied
  comment = "Managed by OpenTofu - ${var.app_name}"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Tunnel Configuration (if managing ingress rules)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Note: Tunnel ingress rules can be managed in two ways:
# 1. Via Cloudflare API (cloudflare_tunnel_config resource)
# 2. Via local config file on the tunnel host
#
# Currently using local config file approach in Traefik LXC.
# To switch to API-managed config, uncomment below:

# =============================================================================
# Network Services LXC - AdGuard + Cloudflared + DDNS
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 101
#
# Core network infrastructure: DNS (AdGuard Home), Cloudflare tunnel, DDNS.
# Tailscale runs as systemd service (requires kernel access).
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  type    = number
  default = 101
}

variable "cores" {
  type    = number
  default = 2
}

variable "memory" {
  type    = number
  default = 2048
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  type    = number
  default = 4
}

variable "cloudflare_ddns_domains" {
  type    = string
  default = "homelab.rambtech.dev"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Network Services Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "network_services" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  name         = "network-services"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network (dual-NIC: container network + LAN for DNS service)
  container_ip = "${local.ip_registry.core.network_services}${local.network.container_netmask}"
  lan_ip       = "${local.lan_ips.network_services}${local.network.lan_netmask}"

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = 1024

  rootfs_storage = "nvme-containers"
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # Privileged for Tailscale kernel access
  unprivileged = false

  # Deployment
  deploy_dir  = "${path.module}/deploy"
  target_path = "/config"

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  proxmox_ssh_host     = var.proxmox_ssh_host

  # Template
  template = var.lxc_template_docker

  # Proxmox Notes
  service_name        = "Network Services"
  service_description = "Core network infrastructure: DNS, tunnels, and VPN"

  service_urls = {
    adguard_internal = "https://dns.${var.domain_internal}"
    adguard_direct   = "http://${local.lan_ips.network_services}:3000"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "AdGuard Home", port = 53, info = "DNS server with ad blocking" },
    { name = "AdGuard UI", port = 3000, info = "Web management interface" },
    { name = "Cloudflared", port = 0, info = "Cloudflare tunnel (outbound only)" },
    { name = "Tailscale", port = 41641, info = "Mesh VPN (systemd service)" }
  ]

  custom_notes = <<-EOT
## Tailscale Management

Tailscale runs as a systemd service (not Docker) because it requires kernel-level network access.

**Check status:**
```bash
systemctl status tailscaled
tailscale status
```

**Restart if needed:**
```bash
systemctl restart tailscaled
```

## Docker Services

**View logs:**
```bash
cd /config && docker compose logs -f <service>
```

**Restart all services:**
```bash
cd /config && docker compose restart
```

## DNS Testing

**Test AdGuard (port 53):**
```bash
dig @${local.lan_ips.network_services} google.com
```

**Test internal DNS rewrites:**
```bash
dig @${local.lan_ips.network_services} traefik.homelab.rambtech.dev
```

## Managed by OpenTofu

Run `task tofu:apply APP=network-services` to update.
EOT

  tags = ["network-services", "dns", "adguard", "cloudflare"]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Create .env file with secrets
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Generate .env file locally with secrets from 1Password, then sync to container

resource "local_sensitive_file" "network_services_env" {
  content = <<-EOT
# Network Services Environment Variables
# Auto-generated by OpenTofu from 1Password
# DO NOT EDIT - changes will be overwritten

# Cloudflare Tunnel Token
CLOUDFLARE_TUNNEL_TOKEN=${local.op.cloudflare_tunnel_token}

# Cloudflare API Token for DDNS
CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN=${local.op.cloudflare_api_token}

# Domains to update with DDNS
CLOUDFLARE_DDNS_DOMAINS=${var.cloudflare_ddns_domains}
EOT

  filename        = "${path.module}/.terraform/network-services.env"
  file_permission = "0600"
}

resource "filesync_file" "network_services_env" {
  source      = local_sensitive_file.network_services_env.filename
  destination = "/config/.env"
  host        = module.network_services.ip_address

  mode = "0600"

  depends_on = [module.network_services]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Tailscale Service Management via Ansible
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Ensures Tailscale daemon is running and connected after deployment

resource "ansible_navigator_run" "manage_tailscale" {
  depends_on = [module.network_services]

  # Re-run when container is rebuilt or network config changes
  triggers = {
    container_id = var.container_id
    lan_ip       = local.lan_ips.network_services
  }

  execution_environment = {
    enabled = false  # Run ansible directly on host
  }

  ansible_options = {
    private_keys = [{
      name = "homelab"
      data = file(var.ssh_private_key_path)
    }]
  }

  playbook = <<-EOT
    - name: Manage Tailscale service on network-services
      hosts: lxc
      gather_facts: no
      vars:
        app_name: network-services

      tasks:
        # =====================================================================
        # Tailscale Service Management
        # =====================================================================
        - name: Ensure Tailscale daemon is running
          ansible.builtin.systemd:
            name: tailscaled
            state: started
            enabled: true
          register: tailscale_service

        - name: Wait for Tailscale to initialize
          ansible.builtin.pause:
            seconds: 3
          when: tailscale_service.changed

        # =====================================================================
        # Verify Tailscale Status
        # =====================================================================
        - name: Check Tailscale connection status
          ansible.builtin.command:
            cmd: tailscale status --json
          register: tailscale_status
          changed_when: false
          failed_when: false

        - name: Parse Tailscale status
          ansible.builtin.set_fact:
            tailscale_info: "{{ tailscale_status.stdout | from_json }}"
          when: tailscale_status.rc == 0

        - name: Display Tailscale connection info
          ansible.builtin.debug:
            msg: |
              Tailscale Status: {{ 'Connected' if (tailscale_info.BackendState | default('')) == 'Running' else 'Not Connected' }}
              Tailnet IP: {{ tailscale_info.Self.TailscaleIPs[0] | default('N/A') }}
              Hostname: {{ tailscale_info.Self.HostName | default('N/A') }}
          when: tailscale_status.rc == 0

        - name: Warn if Tailscale not connected
          ansible.builtin.debug:
            msg: "WARNING: Tailscale is not connected. Check authentication status with 'tailscale status'"
          when: tailscale_status.rc != 0 or (tailscale_info.BackendState | default('')) != 'Running'
  EOT

  inventory = yamlencode({
    lxc = {
      hosts = {
        "network-services" = {
          ansible_host = module.network_services.ip_address
          ansible_user = "root"
        }
      }
    }
  })
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Traefik Route for AdGuard Home UI
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "adguard_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "dns"
  backend_url = "http://${module.network_services.ip_address}:3000"

  internal_domain = "dns.${var.domain_internal}"
  public_domain   = ""  # DNS admin UI should not be public

  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers"]

  depends_on = [module.network_services]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Backup Configuration - PBS Client
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "network_services_sidecars" {
  source = "../../modules/lxc-sidecars"

  container_id   = module.network_services.container_id
  container_ip   = module.network_services.ip_address
  container_name = "network-services"

  proxmox_ssh_host             = var.proxmox_ssh_host
  proxmox_ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  backup = {
    enabled   = true
    schedule  = "Sun 03:00"  # Weekly backup
    retention = "4"          # Keep 4 weekly backups
    namespace = "lxc-101"

    pre_backup_commands = []  # No database - config only

    include_paths = ["/config"]
    exclude_paths = ["/var/lib/docker/overlay2"]

    ntfy_priority = "default"
    ntfy_tags     = "backup,network-services"
  }

  # Container monitoring agents
  pulse_agent = {
    enabled     = true
    pulse_token = local.agent_tokens["network-services"].pulse_token
  }

  arcane_agent = {
    enabled         = true
    bootstrap_token = local.agent_tokens["network-services"].arcane_bootstrap_token
  }

  alloy_agent = {
    enabled  = true
    username = local.op.alloy_telemetry_username
    password = local.op.alloy_telemetry_password
  }

  depends_on = [module.network_services]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Outputs
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

output "container_id" {
  value = module.network_services.container_id
}

output "ip_address" {
  value = module.network_services.ip_address
}

output "ssh_command" {
  value = module.network_services.ssh_command
}

output "urls" {
  value = {
    adguard_internal = module.adguard_route.internal_url
  }
}

output "traefik_config_path" {
  value = module.adguard_route.remote_config_path
}

services:
  # ==========================================================================
  # AdGuard Home - DNS Server with Ad Blocking
  # ==========================================================================
  # Primary DNS server for the network. Uses Cloudflare DNS as upstream.
  # Provides ad blocking, DNS filtering, and local DNS rewrites.
  adguard:
    image: adguard/adguardhome:v0.107.71
    container_name: adguard
    volumes:
      - ./adguard/work:/opt/adguardhome/work
      - ./adguard/conf:/opt/adguardhome/conf
    ports:
      # DNS ports - bind to host IP for network-wide access
      - "53:53/tcp"
      - "53:53/udp"
      # Web UI (AdGuard listens on port 80 internally)
      - "3000:80/tcp"
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '0.5'
        reservations:
          memory: 256m
          cpus: '0.25'
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- http://localhost:80 || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 10s

  # ==========================================================================
  # Cloudflared - Cloudflare Tunnel
  # ==========================================================================
  # Exposes internal services to the internet via Cloudflare Tunnel.
  # No inbound ports required - outbound-only connection to Cloudflare.
  cloudflared:
    image: cloudflare/cloudflared:2025.11.1
    container_name: cloudflared
    command: tunnel --no-autoupdate run
    environment:
      - TUNNEL_TOKEN=${CLOUDFLARE_TUNNEL_TOKEN}
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 256m
          cpus: '0.5'
        reservations:
          memory: 128m
          cpus: '0.25'
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "cloudflared", "version"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 10s

  # ==========================================================================
  # Cloudflare DDNS - Dynamic DNS Updater
  # ==========================================================================
  # Updates Cloudflare DNS records with the current public IP.
  # Useful for services that need direct IP access.
  cloudflare-ddns:
    image: favonia/cloudflare-ddns:1.15.1
    container_name: cloudflare-ddns
    environment:
      - CF_API_TOKEN=${CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN}
      - DOMAINS=${CLOUDFLARE_DDNS_DOMAINS:-homelab.rambtech.dev}
      - PROXIED=false
      - IP6_PROVIDER=none
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 128m
          cpus: '0.25'
        reservations:
          memory: 64m
          cpus: '0.25'
    # Healthcheck removed: favonia/cloudflare-ddns is distroless with no health endpoint
    # Container health monitored via Docker restart policy
    restart: unless-stopped

# =============================================================================
# Authentik LXC - Identity Provider (SSO/OIDC)
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 203
#
# Replaces Authelia with a more feature-rich identity provider:
#   - Native Google/GitHub OAuth federation
#   - OIDC provider for apps with native SSO support
#   - Forward auth for apps without native OAuth
#   - Centralized user/group management
#
# Uses the docker-lxc module - the gold standard pattern for Docker apps.
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  description = "Container ID for Authentik LXC"
  type        = number
  default     = 203
}

variable "cores" {
  description = "CPU cores"
  type        = number
  default     = 2
}

variable "memory" {
  description = "Memory in MB"
  type        = number
  default     = 4096  # Authentik recommended minimum
}

variable "swap" {
  description = "Swap in MB"
  type        = number
  default     = 1024
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  description = "Root filesystem size in GB"
  type        = number
  default     = 16
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Authentik Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "authentik" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  name         = "authentik"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network (container network only - Traefik handles external access)
  container_ip = "${local.ip_registry.dashboards.authentik}${local.network.container_netmask}"

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = var.swap

  rootfs_storage = "nvme-containers"
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # Unprivileged container (security hardened)
  unprivileged = true

  # Deployment
  deploy_dir  = "${path.module}/deploy"
  target_path = "/config"

  # Exclude .env template files (we generate .env from template)
  exclude_patterns = ["^\\.env"]

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  proxmox_ssh_host     = var.proxmox_ssh_host

  # Template with Docker pre-installed
  template = var.lxc_template_docker

  # Proxmox Notes
  service_name        = "Authentik"
  service_description = "Identity Provider - SSO, OIDC, and forward auth for all homelab services"

  service_urls = {
    admin    = "https://auth.${var.domain_internal}/if/admin/"
    user     = "https://auth.${var.domain_internal}/if/user/"
    direct   = "http://${local.ip_registry.dashboards.authentik}:9000"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "Authentik HTTP", port = 9000, info = "Web UI and API" },
    { name = "Authentik HTTPS", port = 9443, info = "HTTPS (self-signed)" },
    { name = "PostgreSQL", port = 5432, info = "Database (internal only)" }
  ]

  custom_notes = <<-EOT
## Initial Setup

1. Access the admin interface at https://auth.${var.domain_internal}/if/admin/
2. Login with credentials from 1Password (item: authentik)
3. Configure Google OAuth source for SSO

## Forward Auth Endpoint

Add this middleware to Traefik routes for protected services:
```yaml
middlewares:
  authentik:
    forwardAuth:
      address: http://${local.ip_registry.dashboards.authentik}:9000/outpost.goauthentik.io/auth/traefik
      trustForwardHeader: true
      authResponseHeaders:
        - X-authentik-username
        - X-authentik-groups
        - X-authentik-email
        - X-authentik-name
        - X-authentik-uid
        - X-authentik-jwt
        - X-authentik-meta-jwks
        - X-authentik-meta-outpost
        - X-authentik-meta-provider
        - X-authentik-meta-app
        - X-authentik-meta-version
```

## Quick Commands

```bash
# View server logs
docker logs -f authentik-server

# View worker logs
docker logs -f authentik-worker

# Database backup
docker exec authentik-postgres pg_dump -U authentik authentik > backup.sql

# Restart services
cd /config && docker compose restart
```

## OIDC Configuration

For apps with native OIDC support, create a Provider in Authentik:
1. Admin → Providers → Create OAuth2/OIDC Provider
2. Set redirect URI for the app
3. Create Application linking to the provider
4. Use client_id and client_secret in the app config

## Managed by OpenTofu

Run `task tofu:apply APP=authentik` to update.
EOT

  tags = ["authentik", "auth", "sso", "oidc", "identity"]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Create .env file with secrets
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Generate .env file locally with secrets from 1Password, then sync to container

resource "local_sensitive_file" "authentik_env" {
  content = templatefile("${path.module}/deploy/.env.tpl", {
    postgres_password = local.op.authentik_postgres_password
    secret_key        = local.op.authentik_secret_key
    admin_email       = "admin@${var.domain_internal}"
    admin_password    = local.op.authentik_admin_password

  host        = module.authentik.ip_address

  depends_on = [module.authentik]
}

module "authentik_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "authentik"
  backend_url = "http://${module.authentik.ip_address}:9000"

  # Internal route (HTTPS via Let's Encrypt)
  # Using "auth" subdomain to match Authelia for easier migration
  internal_domain = "auth.${var.domain_internal}"

  public_middlewares   = ["security-headers"]

}

data "authentik_flow" "default_source_authentication" {

}

data "authentik_flow" "default_source_enrollment" {
  slug = "default-source-enrollment"
}

resource "authentik_source_oauth" "google" {
  name                = "Google"
  slug                = "google"
  authentication_flow = data.authentik_flow.default_source_authentication.id
  enrollment_flow     = data.authentik_flow.default_source_enrollment.id

  provider_type   = "google"

  consumer_secret = local.op.authentik_google_client_secret

  # Allow users to link existing accounts
  user_matching_mode = "identifier"

  # Policy engine mode
  policy_engine_mode = "any"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Backup Configuration - PBS Client + Sidecars
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "authentik_sidecars" {
  source = "../../modules/lxc-sidecars"

  container_id   = module.authentik.container_id
  container_ip   = module.authentik.ip_address
  container_name = "authentik"

Based on the search results, here's what I found about authentik Terraform identification stage sources and OAuth:

## Identification Stage and Sources

Some sources (like the OAuth Source and SAML Source) require user interaction. To make these sources available to users, they can be selected in the Identification stage settings, which will show them below the selected user field.

## Terraform Provider for authentik

The current version of the authentik Terraform provider is 2025.10.1.

### OAuth Source Configuration

You can create OAuth Sources using the Terraform provider with the `authentik_source_oauth` resource. This requires referencing authentication and enrollment flows, and specifying the provider type (such as discord), consumer key, and consumer secret.(no content)The provider supports multiple OAuth provider types including: apple, openidconnect, entraid, azuread, discord, facebook, github, gitlab, google, mailcow, okta, patreon, reddit, twitch, and twitter.(no content)For OIDC sources, you can use `oidc_jwks_url` to automatically configure JWKS if not specified by `oidc_well_known_url`, which automatically configures the source from an OIDC well-known endpoint.

## 2024.8 Release Updates

The authentik 2024.8 release introduced source property mappings for SCIM, OAuth, SAML, and Plex sources. All sources now support property mappings to configure how authentik interprets the incoming source's data, and groups can be synced from all sources that provide group info.(no content)This release also added RBAC support for blueprints and Terraform, allowing permissions to be assigned and automated using both tools.(no content)Several resources in the Terraform provider were renamed to align with new functionality, mainly property mapping-related resources. With the authentik version 2024.8.1 of the Terraform provider, both old and new resources are available, and resources can be moved to the new name using `terraform state mv`.

### Provider Setup

The authentik provider provides resources to interact with the authentik API. You configure it with a URL and token, and can optionally set `insecure` to ignore TLS certificates or add extra headers.

Based on the search results, here's what I found about authentik Terraform identification stage sources and OAuth:

## Identification Stage and Sources

Some sources (like the OAuth Source and SAML Source) require user interaction. To make these sources available to users, they can be selected in the Identification stage settings, which will show them below the selected user field.

## Terraform Provider for authentik

The current version of the authentik Terraform provider is 2025.10.1.

### OAuth Source Configuration

You can create OAuth Sources using the Terraform provider with the `authentik_source_oauth` resource. This requires referencing authentication and enrollment flows, and specifying the provider type (such as discord), consumer key, and consumer secret.(no content)The provider supports multiple OAuth provider types including: apple, openidconnect, entraid, azuread, discord, facebook, github, gitlab, google, mailcow, okta, patreon, reddit, twitch, and twitter.(no content)For OIDC sources, you can use `oidc_jwks_url` to automatically configure JWKS if not specified by `oidc_well_known_url`, which automatically configures the source from an OIDC well-known endpoint.

## 2024.8 Release Updates

The authentik 2024.8 release introduced source property mappings for SCIM, OAuth, SAML, and Plex sources. All sources now support property mappings to configure how authentik interprets the incoming source's data, and groups can be synced from all sources that provide group info.(no content)This release also added RBAC support for blueprints and Terraform, allowing permissions to be assigned and automated using both tools.(no content)Several resources in the Terraform provider were renamed to align with new functionality, mainly property mapping-related resources. With the authentik version 2024.8.1 of the Terraform provider, both old and new resources are available, and resources can be moved to the new name using `terraform state mv`.

### Provider Setup

The authentik provider provides resources to interact with the authentik API. You configure it with a URL and token, and can optionally set `insecure` to ignore TLS certificates or add extra headers.

# =============================================================================
# Authentik LXC - Identity Provider (SSO/OIDC)
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 203
#
# Replaces Authelia with a more feature-rich identity provider:
#   - Native Google/GitHub OAuth federation
#   - OIDC provider for apps with native SSO support
#   - Forward auth for apps without native OAuth
#   - Centralized user/group management
#
# Uses the docker-lxc module - the gold standard pattern for Docker apps.
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  description = "Container ID for Authentik LXC"
  type        = number
  default     = 203
}

variable "cores" {
  description = "CPU cores"
  type        = number
  default     = 2
}

variable "memory" {
  description = "Memory in MB"
  type        = number
  default     = 4096  # Authentik recommended minimum
}

variable "swap" {
  description = "Swap in MB"
  type        = number
  default     = 1024
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  description = "Root filesystem size in GB"
  type        = number
  default     = 16
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Authentik Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "authentik" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  name         = "authentik"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network (container network only - Traefik handles external access)
  container_ip = "${local.ip_registry.dashboards.authentik}${local.network.container_netmask}"

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = var.swap

  rootfs_storage = "nvme-containers"
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # Unprivileged container (security hardened)
  unprivileged = true

  # Deployment
  deploy_dir  = "${path.module}/deploy"
  target_path = "/config"

  # Exclude .env template files (we generate .env from template)
  exclude_patterns = ["^\\.env"]

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  proxmox_ssh_host     = var.proxmox_ssh_host

  # Template with Docker pre-installed
  template = var.lxc_template_docker

  # Proxmox Notes
  service_name        = "Authentik"
  service_description = "Identity Provider - SSO, OIDC, and forward auth for all homelab services"

  service_urls = {
    admin    = "https://auth.${var.domain_internal}/if/admin/"
    user     = "https://auth.${var.domain_internal}/if/user/"
    direct   = "http://${local.ip_registry.dashboards.authentik}:9000"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "Authentik HTTP", port = 9000, info = "Web UI and API" },
    { name = "Authentik HTTPS", port = 9443, info = "HTTPS (self-signed)" },
    { name = "PostgreSQL", port = 5432, info = "Database (internal only)" }
  ]

  custom_notes = <<-EOT
## Initial Setup

1. Access the admin interface at https://auth.${var.domain_internal}/if/admin/
2. Login with credentials from 1Password (item: authentik)
3. Configure Google OAuth source for SSO

## Forward Auth Endpoint

Add this middleware to Traefik routes for protected services:
```yaml
middlewares:
  authentik:
    forwardAuth:
      address: http://${local.ip_registry.dashboards.authentik}:9000/outpost.goauthentik.io/auth/traefik
      trustForwardHeader: true
      authResponseHeaders:
        - X-authentik-username
        - X-authentik-groups
        - X-authentik-email
        - X-authentik-name
        - X-authentik-uid
        - X-authentik-jwt
        - X-authentik-meta-jwks
        - X-authentik-meta-outpost
        - X-authentik-meta-provider
        - X-authentik-meta-app
        - X-authentik-meta-version
```

## Quick Commands

```bash
# View server logs
docker logs -f authentik-server

# View worker logs
docker logs -f authentik-worker

# Database backup
docker exec authentik-postgres pg_dump -U authentik authentik > backup.sql

# Restart services
cd /config && docker compose restart
```

## OIDC Configuration

For apps with native OIDC support, create a Provider in Authentik:
1. Admin → Providers → Create OAuth2/OIDC Provider
2. Set redirect URI for the app
3. Create Application linking to the provider
4. Use client_id and client_secret in the app config

## Managed by OpenTofu

Run `task tofu:apply APP=authentik` to update.
EOT

  tags = ["authentik", "auth", "sso", "oidc", "identity"]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Create .env file with secrets
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Generate .env file locally with secrets from 1Password, then sync to container

resource "local_sensitive_file" "authentik_env" {
  content = templatefile("${path.module}/deploy/.env.tpl", {
    postgres_password = local.op.authentik_postgres_password
    secret_key        = local.op.authentik_secret_key
    admin_email       = "admin@${var.domain_internal}"
    admin_password    = local.op.authentik_admin_password
  })
  filename        = "${path.module}/.terraform/authentik.env"
  file_permission = "0600"
}

resource "filesync_file" "authentik_env" {
  source      = local_sensitive_file.authentik_env.filename
  destination = "/config/.env"
  host        = module.authentik.ip_address

  mode = "0600"

  depends_on = [module.authentik]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Traefik Route - Self-Service Route Registration
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "authentik_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "authentik"
  backend_url = "http://${module.authentik.ip_address}:9000"

  # Internal route (HTTPS via Let's Encrypt)
  # Using "auth" subdomain to match Authelia for easier migration
  internal_domain = "auth.${var.domain_internal}"

  # Public route for external access (Google OAuth redirect)
  public_domain = "auth.${var.domain_public}"

  # Traefik config
  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # No auth middleware on the auth service itself!
  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers"]
  public_middlewares   = ["security-headers"]
  # Use "web" entrypoint for public - Cloudflare handles TLS and forwards HTTP to origin
  public_entrypoint    = ["web"]

  depends_on = [module.authentik]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Traefik Forward Auth Middleware
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Generates the forwardAuth middleware config and syncs to Traefik

resource "local_file" "traefik_middleware" {
  content = templatefile("${path.module}/deploy/traefik-middleware.yml.tpl", {
    authentik_ip = module.authentik.ip_address
  })
  filename = "${path.module}/.terraform/authentik-middleware.yml"
}

resource "filesync_file" "traefik_middleware" {
  source      = local_file.traefik_middleware.filename
  destination = "/config/dynamic/authentik-middleware.yml"
  host        = local.traefik_ip

  mode = "0644"

  depends_on = [module.authentik, local_file.traefik_middleware]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Google OAuth Source - SSO via Google Account
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Allows users to login with their Google account
# Credentials stored in 1Password (authentik item)

data "authentik_flow" "default_source_authentication" {
  slug = "default-source-authentication"
}

data "authentik_flow" "default_source_enrollment" {
  slug = "default-source-enrollment"
}

resource "authentik_source_oauth" "google" {
  name                = "Google"
  slug                = "google"
  authentication_flow = data.authentik_flow.default_source_authentication.id
  enrollment_flow     = data.authentik_flow.default_source_enrollment.id

  provider_type   = "google"
  consumer_key    = local.op.authentik_google_client_id
  consumer_secret = local.op.authentik_google_client_secret

  # Allow users to link existing accounts
  user_matching_mode = "identifier"

  # Policy engine mode
  policy_engine_mode = "any"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Backup Configuration - PBS Client + Sidecars
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "authentik_sidecars" {
  source = "../../modules/lxc-sidecars"

  container_id   = module.authentik.container_id
  container_ip   = module.authentik.ip_address
  container_name = "authentik"

  proxmox_ssh_host             = var.proxmox_ssh_host
  proxmox_ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  backup = {
    enabled   = true
    schedule  = "Sun 03:00"  # Weekly backup
    retention = "4"          # Keep 4 weekly backups
    namespace = "lxc-203"

    # Dump PostgreSQL before backup
    pre_backup_commands = [
      {
        name    = "Backup PostgreSQL database"
        command = "docker exec authentik-postgres pg_dump -U authentik authentik > /config/authentik-db-backup.sql"
        timeout = 120
      }
    ]

    include_paths = ["/config"]
    exclude_paths = ["/var/lib/docker/overlay2"]

    ntfy_priority = "default"
    ntfy_tags     = "backup,authentik"
  }

  # Container monitoring agents
  pulse_agent = {
    enabled     = true
    pulse_token = local.agent_tokens["authentik"].pulse_token
  }

  arcane_agent = {
    enabled         = true
    bootstrap_token = local.agent_tokens["authentik"].arcane_bootstrap_token
  }

  alloy_agent = {
    enabled  = true
    username = local.op.alloy_telemetry_username
    password = local.op.alloy_telemetry_password
  }

  depends_on = [module.authentik]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Outputs
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

output "container_id" {
  value = module.authentik.container_id
}

output "ip_address" {
  value = module.authentik.ip_address
}

output "ssh_command" {
  value = module.authentik.ssh_command
}

output "urls" {
  value = {
    admin  = "https://auth.${var.domain_internal}/if/admin/"
    user   = "https://auth.${var.domain_internal}/if/user/"
    direct = "http://${module.authentik.ip_address}:9000"
  }
}

output "traefik_config_path" {
  description = "Path to Traefik config on Traefik LXC"
  value       = module.authentik_route.remote_config_path
}

output "forward_auth_url" {
  description = "URL for Traefik forwardAuth middleware"
  value       = "http://${module.authentik.ip_address}:9000/outpost.goauthentik.io/auth/traefik"
}

# =============================================================================
# Authentik LXC - Identity Provider (SSO/OIDC)
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 203
#
# Replaces Authelia with a more feature-rich identity provider:
#   - Native Google/GitHub OAuth federation
#   - OIDC provider for apps with native SSO support
#   - Forward auth for apps without native OAuth
#   - Centralized user/group management
#
# Uses the docker-lxc module - the gold standard pattern for Docker apps.
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  description = "Container ID for Authentik LXC"
  type        = number
  default     = 203
}

variable "cores" {
  description = "CPU cores"
  type        = number
  default     = 2
}

variable "memory" {
  description = "Memory in MB"
  type        = number
  default     = 4096  # Authentik recommended minimum
}

variable "swap" {
  description = "Swap in MB"
  type        = number
  default     = 1024
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  description = "Root filesystem size in GB"
  type        = number
  default     = 16
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Authentik Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "authentik" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  name         = "authentik"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network (container network only - Traefik handles external access)
  container_ip = "${local.ip_registry.dashboards.authentik}${local.network.container_netmask}"

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = var.swap

  rootfs_storage = "nvme-containers"
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # Unprivileged container (security hardened)
  unprivileged = true

  # Deployment
  deploy_dir  = "${path.module}/deploy"
  target_path = "/config"

  # Exclude .env template files (we generate .env from template)
  exclude_patterns = ["^\\.env"]

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  proxmox_ssh_host     = var.proxmox_ssh_host

  # Template with Docker pre-installed
  template = var.lxc_template_docker

  # Proxmox Notes
  service_name        = "Authentik"
  service_description = "Identity Provider - SSO, OIDC, and forward auth for all homelab services"

  service_urls = {
    admin    = "https://auth.${var.domain_internal}/if/admin/"
    user     = "https://auth.${var.domain_internal}/if/user/"
    direct   = "http://${local.ip_registry.dashboards.authentik}:9000"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "Authentik HTTP", port = 9000, info = "Web UI and API" },
    { name = "Authentik HTTPS", port = 9443, info = "HTTPS (self-signed)" },
    { name = "PostgreSQL", port = 5432, info = "Database (internal only)" }
  ]

  custom_notes = <<-EOT
## Initial Setup

1. Access the admin interface at https://auth.${var.domain_internal}/if/admin/
2. Login with credentials from 1Password (item: authentik)
3. Configure Google OAuth source for SSO

## Forward Auth Endpoint

Add this middleware to Traefik routes for protected services:
```yaml
middlewares:
  authentik:
    forwardAuth:
      address: http://${local.ip_registry.dashboards.authentik}:9000/outpost.goauthentik.io/auth/traefik
      trustForwardHeader: true
      authResponseHeaders:
        - X-authentik-username
        - X-authentik-groups
        - X-authentik-email
        - X-authentik-name
        - X-authentik-uid
        - X-authentik-jwt
        - X-authentik-meta-jwks
        - X-authentik-meta-outpost
        - X-authentik-meta-provider
        - X-authentik-meta-app
        - X-authentik-meta-version
```

## Quick Commands

```bash
# View server logs
docker logs -f authentik-server

# View worker logs
docker logs -f authentik-worker

# Database backup
docker exec authentik-postgres pg_dump -U authentik authentik > backup.sql

# Restart services
cd /config && docker compose restart
```

## OIDC Configuration

For apps with native OIDC support, create a Provider in Authentik:
1. Admin → Providers → Create OAuth2/OIDC Provider
2. Set redirect URI for the app
3. Create Application linking to the provider
4. Use client_id and client_secret in the app config

## Managed by OpenTofu

Run `task tofu:apply APP=authentik` to update.
EOT

  tags = ["authentik", "auth", "sso", "oidc", "identity"]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Create .env file with secrets
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Generate .env file locally with secrets from 1Password, then sync to container

resource "local_sensitive_file" "authentik_env" {
  content = templatefile("${path.module}/deploy/.env.tpl", {
    postgres_password = local.op.authentik_postgres_password
    secret_key        = local.op.authentik_secret_key
    admin_email       = "admin@${var.domain_internal}"
    admin_password    = local.op.authentik_admin_password
  })
  filename        = "${path.module}/.terraform/authentik.env"
  file_permission = "0600"
}

resource "filesync_file" "authentik_env" {
  source      = local_sensitive_file.authentik_env.filename
  destination = "/config/.env"
  host        = module.authentik.ip_address

  mode = "0600"

  depends_on = [module.authentik]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Traefik Route - Self-Service Route Registration
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "authentik_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "authentik"
  backend_url = "http://${module.authentik.ip_address}:9000"

  # Internal route (HTTPS via Let's Encrypt)
  # Using "auth" subdomain to match Authelia for easier migration
  internal_domain = "auth.${var.domain_internal}"

  # Public route for external access (Google OAuth redirect)
  public_domain = "auth.${var.domain_public}"

  # Traefik config
  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # No auth middleware on the auth service itself!
  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers"]
  public_middlewares   = ["security-headers"]

  public_entrypoint    = ["web"]

resource "filesync_file" "traefik_middleware" {

  mode = "0644"

}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Google OAuth Source - SSO via Google Account
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Allows users to login with their Google account

data "authentik_flow" "default_source_authentication" {
  slug = "default-source-authentication"
}

data "authentik_flow" "default_source_enrollment" {
  slug = "default-source-enrollment"
}

resource "authentik_source_oauth" "google" {
  name                = "Google"
  slug                = "google"
  authentication_flow = data.authentik_flow.default_source_authentication.id

  # Policy engine mode
  policy_engine_mode = "any"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Link Google OAuth to Login Flow
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

data "authentik_stage" "default_authentication_identification" {
  name = "default-authentication-identification"
}

resource "authentik_stage_identification" "default_with_google" {
  name           = "default-authentication-identification"
  user_fields    = ["username", "email"]
  sources        = [authentik_source_oauth.google.uuid]
  show_source_labels = true
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Backup Configuration - PBS Client + Sidecars
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "authentik_sidecars" {
  source = "../../modules/lxc-sidecars"

  container_id   = module.authentik.container_id
  container_ip   = module.authentik.ip_address
  container_name = "authentik"

  proxmox_ssh_host             = var.proxmox_ssh_host
  proxmox_ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  backup = {
    enabled   = true
    schedule  = "Sun 03:00"  # Weekly backup
    retention = "4"          # Keep 4 weekly backups
    namespace = "lxc-203"

    # Dump PostgreSQL before backup
    pre_backup_commands = [
      {
        name    = "Backup PostgreSQL database"
        command = "docker exec authentik-postgres pg_dump -U authentik authentik > /config/authentik-db-backup.sql"
        timeout = 120
      }
    ]

    include_paths = ["/config"]
    exclude_paths = ["/var/lib/docker/overlay2"]

    ntfy_priority = "default"
    ntfy_tags     = "backup,authentik"
  }

  # Container monitoring agents
  pulse_agent = {
    enabled     = true
    pulse_token = local.agent_tokens["authentik"].pulse_token
  }

  arcane_agent = {
    enabled         = true
    bootstrap_token = local.agent_tokens["authentik"].arcane_bootstrap_token
  }

  alloy_agent = {
    enabled  = true
    username = local.op.alloy_telemetry_username
    password = local.op.alloy_telemetry_password
  }

  depends_on = [module.authentik]
}

output "container_id" {

output "ip_address" {

output "ssh_command" {

content.text:
Yes, exactly. With the current configuration:

**New users via Google OAuth:**
1. Click "Login with Google" on the authentik login page
2. Authenticate with Google
3. Authentik checks if a user with that email exists
4. If not found → enrollment flow asks them to pick a username
5. New authentik user is created and linked to their Google account
6. Future logins with Google are automatic (no enrollment needed)

**Existing users:**
- If you pre-create a user in authentik with a matching email, Google OAuth will automatically link to that account (because `user_matching_mode: identifier` matches by email)

This is a good setup for a homelab - you control who can access by:
1. **Google Cloud Console** - Only your Google account(s) can authenticate (you can restrict OAuth to specific emails/domains in GCP)
2. **Authentik policies** - Add restrictions on who can enroll or access specific apps

If you want to lock it down further, you could:
- Disable enrollment and pre-create all users manually
- Add a policy to the enrollment flow requiring email domain matching
- Use Google Workspace and restrict OAuth to your domain

For now, the current setup works well - complete the enrollment flow with your Google account and you'll have your primary user set up. Then for forward auth on other services, you can control access via authentik applications and policies.

# =============================================================================
# Authentik LXC - Identity Provider (SSO/OIDC)
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 203
#
# Replaces Authelia with a more feature-rich identity provider:
#   - Native Google/GitHub OAuth federation
#   - OIDC provider for apps with native SSO support
#   - Forward auth for apps without native OAuth
#   - Centralized user/group management
#
# Uses the docker-lxc module - the gold standard pattern for Docker apps.
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  description = "Container ID for Authentik LXC"
  type        = number
  default     = 203
}

variable "cores" {
  description = "CPU cores"
  type        = number
  default     = 2
}

variable "memory" {
  description = "Memory in MB"
  type        = number
  default     = 4096  # Authentik recommended minimum
}

variable "swap" {
  description = "Swap in MB"
  type        = number
  default     = 1024
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  description = "Root filesystem size in GB"
  type        = number
  default     = 16
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Authentik Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "authentik" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  name         = "authentik"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network (container network only - Traefik handles external access)
  container_ip = "${local.ip_registry.dashboards.authentik}${local.network.container_netmask}"

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = var.swap

  rootfs_storage = "nvme-containers"
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # Unprivileged container (security hardened)
  unprivileged = true

  # Deployment
  deploy_dir  = "${path.module}/deploy"
  target_path = "/config"

  # Exclude .env template files (we generate .env from template)
  exclude_patterns = ["^\\.env"]

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  proxmox_ssh_host     = var.proxmox_ssh_host

  # Template with Docker pre-installed
  template = var.lxc_template_docker

  # Proxmox Notes
  service_name        = "Authentik"
  service_description = "Identity Provider - SSO, OIDC, and forward auth for all homelab services"

  service_urls = {
    admin    = "https://auth.${var.domain_internal}/if/admin/"
    user     = "https://auth.${var.domain_internal}/if/user/"
    direct   = "http://${local.ip_registry.dashboards.authentik}:9000"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "Authentik HTTP", port = 9000, info = "Web UI and API" },
    { name = "Authentik HTTPS", port = 9443, info = "HTTPS (self-signed)" },
    { name = "PostgreSQL", port = 5432, info = "Database (internal only)" }
  ]

  custom_notes = <<-EOT
## Initial Setup

1. Access the admin interface at https://auth.${var.domain_internal}/if/admin/
2. Login with credentials from 1Password (item: authentik)
3. Configure Google OAuth source for SSO

## Forward Auth Endpoint

Add this middleware to Traefik routes for protected services:
```yaml
middlewares:
  authentik:
    forwardAuth:
      address: http://${local.ip_registry.dashboards.authentik}:9000/outpost.goauthentik.io/auth/traefik
      trustForwardHeader: true
      authResponseHeaders:
        - X-authentik-username
        - X-authentik-groups
        - X-authentik-email
        - X-authentik-name
        - X-authentik-uid
        - X-authentik-jwt
        - X-authentik-meta-jwks
        - X-authentik-meta-outpost
        - X-authentik-meta-provider
        - X-authentik-meta-app
        - X-authentik-meta-version
```

## Quick Commands

```bash
# View server logs
docker logs -f authentik-server

# View worker logs
docker logs -f authentik-worker

# Database backup
docker exec authentik-postgres pg_dump -U authentik authentik > backup.sql

# Restart services
cd /config && docker compose restart
```

## OIDC Configuration

For apps with native OIDC support, create a Provider in Authentik:
1. Admin → Providers → Create OAuth2/OIDC Provider
2. Set redirect URI for the app
3. Create Application linking to the provider
4. Use client_id and client_secret in the app config

## Managed by OpenTofu

Run `task tofu:apply APP=authentik` to update.
EOT

  tags = ["authentik", "auth", "sso", "oidc", "identity"]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Create .env file with secrets
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Generate .env file locally with secrets from 1Password, then sync to container

resource "local_sensitive_file" "authentik_env" {
  content = templatefile("${path.module}/deploy/.env.tpl", {
    postgres_password = local.op.authentik_postgres_password
    secret_key        = local.op.authentik_secret_key
    admin_email       = "admin@${var.domain_internal}"
    admin_password    = local.op.authentik_admin_password
  })
  filename        = "${path.module}/.terraform/authentik.env"
  file_permission = "0600"
}

resource "filesync_file" "authentik_env" {
  source      = local_sensitive_file.authentik_env.filename
  destination = "/config/.env"
  host        = module.authentik.ip_address

  mode = "0600"

  depends_on = [module.authentik]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Traefik Route - Self-Service Route Registration
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "authentik_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "authentik"
  backend_url = "http://${module.authentik.ip_address}:9000"

  # Internal route (HTTPS via Let's Encrypt)
  # Using "auth" subdomain to match Authelia for easier migration
  internal_domain = "auth.${var.domain_internal}"

  # Public route for external access (Google OAuth redirect)
  public_domain = "auth.${var.domain_public}"

  # Traefik config
  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # No auth middleware on the auth service itself!
  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers"]
  public_middlewares   = ["security-headers"]
  # Use "web" entrypoint for public - Cloudflare handles TLS and forwards HTTP to origin
  public_entrypoint    = ["web"]

  depends_on = [module.authentik]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Traefik Forward Auth Middleware
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Generates the forwardAuth middleware config and syncs to Traefik

resource "local_file" "traefik_middleware" {
  content = templatefile("${path.module}/deploy/traefik-middleware.yml.tpl", {
    authentik_ip = module.authentik.ip_address
  })
  filename = "${path.module}/.terraform/authentik-middleware.yml"
}

resource "filesync_file" "traefik_middleware" {
  source      = local_file.traefik_middleware.filename
  destination = "/config/dynamic/authentik-middleware.yml"
  host        = local.traefik_ip

  mode = "0644"

  depends_on = [module.authentik, local_file.traefik_middleware]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Google OAuth Source - SSO via Google Account
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Allows users to login with their Google account
# Credentials stored in 1Password (authentik item)

data "authentik_flow" "default_source_authentication" {
  slug = "default-source-authentication"
}

data "authentik_flow" "default_source_enrollment" {
  slug = "default-source-enrollment"
}

resource "authentik_source_oauth" "google" {
  name                = "Google"
  slug                = "google"
  authentication_flow = data.authentik_flow.default_source_authentication.id
  enrollment_flow     = data.authentik_flow.default_source_enrollment.id

  provider_type   = "google"
  consumer_key    = local.op.authentik_google_client_id
  consumer_secret = local.op.authentik_google_client_secret

  # Allow users to link existing accounts
  user_matching_mode = "identifier"

  # Policy engine mode
  policy_engine_mode = "any"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Link Google OAuth to Login Flow
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# NOTE: The Google source must be manually added to the identification stage
# in the authentik admin UI:
#   1. Go to Flows & Stages → Stages
#   2. Edit "default-authentication-identification"
#   3. Add "Google" to the Sources field
#   4. Save
#
# This is required because the stage already exists and can't be recreated
# via Terraform without importing it first.

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Backup Configuration - PBS Client + Sidecars
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "authentik_sidecars" {
  source = "../../modules/lxc-sidecars"

  container_id   = module.authentik.container_id
  container_ip   = module.authentik.ip_address
  container_name = "authentik"

  proxmox_ssh_host             = var.proxmox_ssh_host
  proxmox_ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  backup = {
    enabled   = true
    schedule  = "Sun 03:00"  # Weekly backup
    retention = "4"          # Keep 4 weekly backups
    namespace = "lxc-203"

    # Dump PostgreSQL before backup
    pre_backup_commands = [
      {
        name    = "Backup PostgreSQL database"
        command = "docker exec authentik-postgres pg_dump -U authentik authentik > /config/authentik-db-backup.sql"
        timeout = 120
      }
    ]

    include_paths = ["/config"]
    exclude_paths = ["/var/lib/docker/overlay2"]

    ntfy_priority = "default"
    ntfy_tags     = "backup,authentik"
  }

  # Container monitoring agents
  pulse_agent = {
    enabled     = true
    pulse_token = local.agent_tokens["authentik"].pulse_token
  }

  arcane_agent = {
    enabled         = true
    bootstrap_token = local.agent_tokens["authentik"].arcane_bootstrap_token
  }

  alloy_agent = {
    enabled  = true
    username = local.op.alloy_telemetry_username
    password = local.op.alloy_telemetry_password
  }

  depends_on = [module.authentik]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Outputs
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

output "container_id" {
  value = module.authentik.container_id
}

output "ip_address" {
  value = module.authentik.ip_address
}

output "ssh_command" {
  value = module.authentik.ssh_command
}

output "urls" {
  value = {
    admin  = "https://auth.${var.domain_internal}/if/admin/"
    user   = "https://auth.${var.domain_internal}/if/user/"
    direct = "http://${module.authentik.ip_address}:9000"
  }
}

output "traefik_config_path" {
  description = "Path to Traefik config on Traefik LXC"
  value       = module.authentik_route.remote_config_path
}

output "forward_auth_url" {
  description = "URL for Traefik forwardAuth middleware"
  value       = "http://${module.authentik.ip_address}:9000/outpost.goauthentik.io/auth/traefik"
}
