# =============================================================================
# Authentik LXC - Identity Provider (SSO/OIDC)
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 203
#
# Replaces Authelia with a more feature-rich identity provider:
#   - Native Google/GitHub OAuth federation
#   - OIDC provider for apps with native SSO support
#   - Forward auth for apps without native OAuth
#   - Centralized user/group management
#
# Uses the docker-lxc module - the gold standard pattern for Docker apps.
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  description = "Container ID for Authentik LXC"
  type        = number
  default     = 203
}

variable "cores" {
  description = "CPU cores"
  type        = number
  default     = 2
}

variable "memory" {
  description = "Memory in MB"
  type        = number
  default     = 4096  # Authentik recommended minimum
}

variable "swap" {
  description = "Swap in MB"
  type        = number
  default     = 1024
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  description = "Root filesystem size in GB"
  type        = number
  default     = 16
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Authentik Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "authentik" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  name         = "authentik"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network (container network only - Traefik handles external access)
  container_ip = "${local.ip_registry.dashboards.authentik}${local.network.container_netmask}"

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = var.swap

  rootfs_storage = "nvme-containers"
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # Unprivileged container (security hardened)
  unprivileged = true

  # Deployment
  deploy_dir  = "${path.module}/deploy"
  target_path = "/config"

  # Exclude .env template files (we generate .env from template)
  exclude_patterns = ["^\\.env"]

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  proxmox_ssh_host     = var.proxmox_ssh_host

  # Template with Docker pre-installed
  template = var.lxc_template_docker

  # Proxmox Notes
  service_name        = "Authentik"
  service_description = "Identity Provider - SSO, OIDC, and forward auth for all homelab services"

  service_urls = {
    admin    = "https://auth.${var.domain_internal}/if/admin/"
    user     = "https://auth.${var.domain_internal}/if/user/"
    direct   = "http://${local.ip_registry.dashboards.authentik}:9000"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "Authentik HTTP", port = 9000, info = "Web UI and API" },
    { name = "Authentik HTTPS", port = 9443, info = "HTTPS (self-signed)" },
    { name = "PostgreSQL", port = 5432, info = "Database (internal only)" }
  ]

  custom_notes = <<-EOT
## Initial Setup

1. Access the admin interface at https://auth.${var.domain_internal}/if/admin/
2. Login with credentials from 1Password (item: authentik)
3. Configure Google OAuth source for SSO

## Forward Auth Endpoint

Add this middleware to Traefik routes for protected services:
```yaml
middlewares:
  authentik:
    forwardAuth:
      address: http://${local.ip_registry.dashboards.authentik}:9000/outpost.goauthentik.io/auth/traefik
      trustForwardHeader: true
      authResponseHeaders:
        - X-authentik-username
        - X-authentik-groups
        - X-authentik-email
        - X-authentik-name
        - X-authentik-uid
        - X-authentik-jwt
        - X-authentik-meta-jwks
        - X-authentik-meta-outpost
        - X-authentik-meta-provider
        - X-authentik-meta-app
        - X-authentik-meta-version
```

## Quick Commands

```bash
# View server logs
docker logs -f authentik-server

# View worker logs
docker logs -f authentik-worker

# Database backup
docker exec authentik-postgres pg_dump -U authentik authentik > backup.sql

# Restart services
cd /config && docker compose restart
```

## OIDC Configuration

For apps with native OIDC support, create a Provider in Authentik:
1. Admin → Providers → Create OAuth2/OIDC Provider
2. Set redirect URI for the app
3. Create Application linking to the provider
4. Use client_id and client_secret in the app config

## Managed by OpenTofu

Run `task tofu:apply APP=authentik` to update.
EOT

  tags = ["authentik", "auth", "sso", "oidc", "identity"]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Create .env file with secrets
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Generate .env file locally with secrets from 1Password, then sync to container

resource "local_sensitive_file" "authentik_env" {
  content = templatefile("${path.module}/deploy/.env.tpl", {
    postgres_password = local.op.authentik_postgres_password
    secret_key        = local.op.authentik_secret_key
    admin_email       = "admin@${var.domain_internal}"
    admin_password    = local.op.authentik_admin_password
  })
  filename        = "${path.module}/.terraform/authentik.env"
  file_permission = "0600"
}

resource "filesync_file" "authentik_env" {
  source      = local_sensitive_file.authentik_env.filename
  destination = "/config/.env"
  host        = module.authentik.ip_address

  mode = "0600"

  depends_on = [module.authentik]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Traefik Route - Self-Service Route Registration
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "authentik_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "authentik"
  backend_url = "http://${module.authentik.ip_address}:9000"

  # Internal route (HTTPS via Let's Encrypt)
  # Using "auth" subdomain to match Authelia for easier migration
  internal_domain = "auth.${var.domain_internal}"

  # Public route for external access (Google OAuth redirect)
  public_domain = "auth.${var.domain_public}"

  # Traefik config
  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # No auth middleware on the auth service itself!
  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers"]
  public_middlewares   = ["security-headers"]
  # Use "web" entrypoint for public - Cloudflare handles TLS and forwards HTTP to origin
  public_entrypoint    = ["web"]

  depends_on = [module.authentik]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Traefik Forward Auth Middleware
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Generates the forwardAuth middleware config and syncs to Traefik

resource "local_file" "traefik_middleware" {
  content = templatefile("${path.module}/deploy/traefik-middleware.yml.tpl", {
    authentik_ip = module.authentik.ip_address
  })
  filename = "${path.module}/.terraform/authentik-middleware.yml"
}

resource "filesync_file" "traefik_middleware" {
  source      = local_file.traefik_middleware.filename
  destination = "/config/dynamic/authentik-middleware.yml"
  host        = local.traefik_ip

  mode = "0644"

  depends_on = [module.authentik, local_file.traefik_middleware]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Terraform API Token - Non-expiring
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Creates a non-expiring API token for Terraform to manage authentik.
# The token value is stored in 1Password and used by the provider.
#
# Bootstrap: Create a short-lived token in UI first, run tofu apply,
# then update 1Password with the new token value from the output.

data "authentik_user" "akadmin" {
  username = "akadmin"
}

resource "authentik_token" "terraform" {
  identifier   = "terraform-api"
  user         = data.authentik_user.akadmin.id
  intent       = "api"
  expiring     = false  # Never expires
  description  = "API token for OpenTofu/Terraform - managed by IaC"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Google OAuth Source - SSO via Google Account
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Allows users to login with their Google account
# Credentials stored in 1Password (authentik item)

data "authentik_flow" "default_source_authentication" {
  slug = "default-source-authentication"
}

resource "authentik_source_oauth" "google" {
  name                = "Google"
  slug                = "google"
  authentication_flow = data.authentik_flow.default_source_authentication.id

  # No enrollment flow - users must be pre-created in authentik
  # This prevents unauthorized users from self-registering
  enrollment_flow = ""

  provider_type   = "google"
  consumer_key    = local.op.authentik_google_client_id
  consumer_secret = local.op.authentik_google_client_secret

  # Match users by email identifier
  user_matching_mode = "identifier"

  # Policy engine mode
  policy_engine_mode = "any"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Link Google OAuth to Login Flow
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# NOTE: The Google source must be manually added to the identification stage
# in the authentik admin UI:
#   1. Go to Flows & Stages → Stages
#   2. Edit "default-authentication-identification"
#   3. Add "Google" to the Sources field
#   4. Save
#
# This is required because the stage already exists and can't be recreated
# via Terraform without importing it first.

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Users - Managed via SOPS encrypted file
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Users who can login via Google OAuth. Email must match their Google account.
# Edit with: sops edit tofu/apps/authentik/users.sops.yaml

data "sops_file" "users" {
  source_file = "${path.module}/users.sops.yaml"
}

locals {
  authentik_users = yamldecode(data.sops_file.users.raw).authentik_users
}

resource "authentik_user" "users" {
  for_each = local.authentik_users

  username = each.key
  email    = each.value.email
  name     = each.value.name

  # Users authenticate via Google OAuth, no local password needed
  # They can set one later if desired via the user portal
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Backup Configuration - PBS Client + Sidecars
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "authentik_sidecars" {
  source = "../../modules/lxc-sidecars"

  container_id   = module.authentik.container_id
  container_ip   = module.authentik.ip_address
  container_name = "authentik"

  proxmox_ssh_host             = var.proxmox_ssh_host
  proxmox_ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  backup = {
    enabled   = true
    schedule  = "Sun 03:00"  # Weekly backup
    retention = "4"          # Keep 4 weekly backups
    namespace = "lxc-203"

    # Dump PostgreSQL before backup
    pre_backup_commands = [
      {
        name    = "Backup PostgreSQL database"
        command = "docker exec authentik-postgres pg_dump -U authentik authentik > /config/authentik-db-backup.sql"
        timeout = 120
      }
    ]

    include_paths = ["/config"]
    exclude_paths = ["/var/lib/docker/overlay2"]

    ntfy_priority = "default"
    ntfy_tags     = "backup,authentik"
  }

  # Container monitoring agents
  pulse_agent = {
    enabled     = true
    pulse_token = local.agent_tokens["authentik"].pulse_token
  }

  arcane_agent = {
    enabled         = true
    bootstrap_token = local.agent_tokens["authentik"].arcane_bootstrap_token
  }

  alloy_agent = {
    enabled  = true
    username = local.op.alloy_telemetry_username
    password = local.op.alloy_telemetry_password
  }

  depends_on = [module.authentik]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Outputs
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

output "container_id" {
  value = module.authentik.container_id
}

output "ip_address" {
  value = module.authentik.ip_address
}

output "ssh_command" {
  value = module.authentik.ssh_command
}

output "urls" {
  value = {
    admin  = "https://auth.${var.domain_internal}/if/admin/"
    user   = "https://auth.${var.domain_internal}/if/user/"
    direct = "http://${module.authentik.ip_address}:9000"
  }
}

output "traefik_config_path" {
  description = "Path to Traefik config on Traefik LXC"
  value       = module.authentik_route.remote_config_path
}

output "terraform_api_token" {
  description = "API token for Terraform - update 1Password with this value"
  value       = authentik_token.terraform.key
  sensitive   = true
}

output "forward_auth_url" {
  description = "URL for Traefik forwardAuth middleware"
  value       = "http://${module.authentik.ip_address}:9000/outpost.goauthentik.io/auth/traefik"
}

**SOPS Encryption for Authentik Users**

Here's what I found about SOPS YAML config and age key file path locations:

## SOPS Age Key File Path Locations

### Default Key File Location
SOPS looks for age keys at the default location `/home/<user>/.config/sops/age/keys.txt`.(no content)The only way to get SOPS to decrypt without explicitly specifying a key path is to place the converted age key in that default location.

### Alternative Key Location
You can create an encryption key file named "key.txt" and copy it to the location `~/.sops/key.txt`.

### Environment Variable Configuration
You can set the `SOPS_AGE_KEY_FILE` environment variable to specify the path to your age key file, for example: `export SOPS_AGE_KEY_FILE=$(pwd)/secrets/age-key.txt`(no content)`SOPS_AGE_KEY_FILE` is the path to your age.agekey file. You can replace your old key file with a new one so that `SOPS_AGE_KEY_FILE` references the updated key.

### .sops.yaml Configuration File
If your secrets are stored under a specific directory, like a git repository, you can create a `.sops.yaml` configuration file at the root directory to define which keys are used for which filename.(no content)When SOPS encrypts a file, it looks for a `.sops.yaml` configuration file. If one is found, the filename of the file being created is compared with the filename regexes of the configuration file. The first regex that matches is selected, and its KMS and PGP keys are used to encrypt the file. Note that the lookup of `.sops.yaml` is from the working directory (CWD) instead of the directory of the encrypting file.

### Example .sops.yaml with Age Keys
In `.sops.yaml`, creation rules are evaluated sequentially, with the first match winning. You can specify age keys directly in the configuration using path_regex patterns like `\.dev\.yaml$` with the `age:` field containing the public key.(no content)When adding multiple age keys, you need to separate the keys by comma, not by space in the configuration.

input.prompt: Find if .sops.yaml config file can specify the age key file path location for decryption, or if it only supports environment variables like SOPS_AGE_KEY_FILE

content.content:
# SOPS Age Key File Path Configuration

Based on the documentation provided, **.sops.yaml cannot specify the age key file path location**. The configuration file only supports defining age recipients for encryption, not key file paths for decryption.

For decryption, SOPS only supports environment variables to override the default age key file location:

- **SOPS_AGE_KEY_FILE** - Sets a custom path to the keys.txt file
- **SOPS_AGE_KEY** - Provides the age key directly as an environment variable
- **SOPS_AGE_KEY_CMD** - Specifies a command to output age keys

The documentation states: "You can override the default lookup by: setting the environment variable **SOPS_AGE_KEY_FILE**; setting the **SOPS_AGE_KEY** environment variable; providing a command to output the age keys by setting the **SOPS_AGE_KEY_CMD** environment variable."

The `.sops.yaml` file's role is limited to "adding a list of age recipients" for encryption configuration only.

content.text:
The `.sops.yaml` file **only configures encryption** (which public keys to use). For decryption, SOPS uses environment variables:

| Variable | Purpose |
|----------|---------|
| `SOPS_AGE_KEY` | Key content directly |
| `SOPS_AGE_KEY_FILE` | Path to key file |
| `SOPS_AGE_KEY_CMD` | Command that outputs key |

If you want to pull from 1Password instead of the local file, add this to your shell profile (`.zshrc`):

```bash
export SOPS_AGE_KEY_CMD="op read 'op://homelab/sops-age-key/private_key'"
```

This way you don't need the local key file at all - it'll use 1Password directly with biometric auth.

Sources:
- [SOPS GitHub](https://github.com/getsops/sops)
- [SOPS with Age encryption guide](https://sleeplessbeastie.eu/2024/03/20/how-to-utilize-sops-with-age-encryption/)

# Homelab Infrastructure Automation
# https://taskfile.dev

version: '3'

vars:
  PROJECT_ROOT: "{{.TASKFILE_DIR}}"
  TOFU_DIR: "{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/tofu"

env:
  # State encryption passphrase - MUST be TF_VAR because encryption runs before providers
  # All other secrets are now fetched via 1Password provider directly in OpenTofu
  TF_VAR_state_encryption_passphrase:
    sh: |
      if [ -n "$TF_VAR_state_encryption_passphrase" ]; then
        echo "$TF_VAR_state_encryption_passphrase"
      else
        op read "op://homelab/opentofu/password" 2>/dev/null || echo ""
      fi

# =============================================================================
# Included Taskfiles (flattened into main namespace)
# =============================================================================
includes:
  tofu:
    taskfile: ./tasks/tofu.yml
    flatten: true
    vars:
      PROJECT_ROOT: "{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}"
  backup:
    taskfile: ./tasks/backup.yml
    flatten: true
    vars:
      PROJECT_ROOT: "{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}"
  cloud:
    taskfile: ./tasks/cloud.yml
    flatten: true
    vars:
      PROJECT_ROOT: "{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}"
  template:
    taskfile: ./tasks/template.yml
    flatten: true
    vars:
      PROJECT_ROOT: "{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}"
  pbs:
    taskfile: ./tasks/pbs.yml
    flatten: true
    vars:
      PROJECT_ROOT: "{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}"
  importer:
    taskfile: ./tasks/immich-importer.yml
    vars:
      PROJECT_ROOT: "{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}"
  beads:
    taskfile: ./tasks/beads.yml
    flatten: true
    vars:
      PROJECT_ROOT: "{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}"

tasks:
  # ===========================================================================
  # Desktop LXC (Temporary GUI for Downloads)
  # ===========================================================================

  desktop:create:
    desc: "Create temporary GUI desktop LXC for downloading Google Takeout"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/desktop-lxc/create.sh

  desktop:destroy:
    desc: "Destroy temporary GUI desktop LXC"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/desktop-lxc/destroy.sh

  desktop:info:
    desc: "Show VNC connection info for desktop LXC"
    cmds:
      - |
        IP=$(ssh root@homelab "pct exec 600 -- ip -4 addr show eth0 | grep inet | awk '{print \$2}' | cut -d/ -f1" 2>/dev/null)
        if [ -z "$IP" ]; then
          echo "Desktop LXC (600) is not running or does not exist."
          echo "Run 'task desktop:create' first."
          exit 1
        fi
        echo "=== Desktop LXC VNC Connection ==="
        echo ""
        echo "VNC Host: $IP:5901"
        echo ""
        echo "macOS: Open Finder, Cmd+K, enter vnc://$IP:5901"
        echo ""
        echo "Downloads save to: /downloads (mounted to /tank/photo-import)"

  desktop:restart-vnc:
    desc: "Restart VNC server on desktop LXC"
    cmds:
      - |
        echo "Restarting VNC server..."
        ssh root@homelab "pct exec 600 -- bash -c 'vncserver -kill :1 2>/dev/null || true; vncserver :1 -geometry 1920x1080 -depth 24 -localhost no'"
        echo "VNC server restarted on display :1"

  # ===========================================================================
  # Authelia Operations
  # ===========================================================================

  authelia:secrets:
    desc: "Generate Authelia secrets from 1Password"
    cmds:
      - |
        SECRETS_DIR="{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/tofu/apps/authelia/deploy/secrets"
        mkdir -p "$SECRETS_DIR"
        echo "Fetching secrets from 1Password..."
        op read "op://homelab/authelia/jwt_secret" > "$SECRETS_DIR/jwt_secret"
        op read "op://homelab/authelia/session_secret" > "$SECRETS_DIR/session_secret"
        op read "op://homelab/authelia/storage_encryption_key" > "$SECRETS_DIR/storage_encryption_key"
        op read "op://homelab/authelia/oidc_hmac_secret" > "$SECRETS_DIR/oidc_hmac_secret"
        op read "op://homelab/authelia/oidc_private_key" > "$SECRETS_DIR/oidc_private_key"
        chmod 600 "$SECRETS_DIR"/*
        echo "Secrets written to $SECRETS_DIR"

  authelia:users:
    desc: "Generate Authelia users database from 1Password"
    cmds:
      - |
        USERS_FILE="{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/tofu/apps/authelia/deploy/authelia/users_database.yml"
        HASH=$(op read "op://homelab/authelia/admin_password_hash")
        if [ "$HASH" = "PLACEHOLDER_RUN_DOCKER_TO_GENERATE" ]; then
          echo "ERROR: admin_password_hash is still a placeholder."
          echo "Run: docker run --rm -it authelia/authelia:latest authelia crypto hash generate argon2"
          echo "Then update 1Password: op item edit authelia --vault=homelab 'admin_password_hash=YOUR_HASH'"
          exit 1
        fi
        echo "users:" > "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "  admin:" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "    displayname: \"Admin\"" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "    email: admin@homelab.rambtech.dev" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "    password: \"$HASH\"" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "    groups:" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "      - admins" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "      - users" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "Users database written to $USERS_FILE"

  authelia:setup:
    desc: "Full Authelia setup (secrets + users)"
    cmds:
      - task: authelia:secrets
      - task: authelia:users
      - echo "Authelia setup complete. Run 'task tofu:apply APP=authelia' to deploy."

  # ===========================================================================
  # Authentik Operations (Identity Provider - replaces Authelia)
  # ===========================================================================

  authentik:deploy:
    desc: "Deploy Authentik LXC container"
    cmds:
      - task: tofu:apply
        vars:
          APP: authentik

  authentik:status:
    desc: "Check Authentik container status"
    cmds:
      - |
        IP=$(cd {{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/tofu/apps/authentik && tofu output -raw ip_address 2>/dev/null || echo "")
        if [ -z "$IP" ]; then
          echo "Authentik not deployed yet. Run 'task authentik:deploy' first."
          exit 1
        fi
        echo "=== Authentik Status ==="
        echo ""
        echo "Container IP: $IP"
        echo ""
        echo "Checking services..."
        ssh root@$IP "cd /config && docker compose ps" 2>/dev/null || echo "Cannot connect to container"
        echo ""
        echo "URLs:"
        echo "  Admin:  https://auth.homelab.rambtech.dev/if/admin/"
        echo "  User:   https://auth.homelab.rambtech.dev/if/user/"
        echo "  Direct: http://$IP:9000"

  authentik:logs:
    desc: "View Authentik logs (server, worker, or postgres)"
    cmds:
      - |
        IP=$(cd {{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/tofu/apps/authentik && tofu output -raw ip_address 2>/dev/null)
        SERVICE="${SERVICE:-server}"
        echo "Viewing logs for authentik-$SERVICE..."
        ssh root@$IP "docker logs -f authentik-$SERVICE --tail=100"
    vars:
      SERVICE: '{{.SERVICE | default "server"}}'

  authentik:restart:
    desc: "Restart Authentik services"
    cmds:
      - |
        IP=$(cd {{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/tofu/apps/authentik && tofu output -raw ip_address 2>/dev/null)
        echo "Restarting Authentik services..."
        ssh root@$IP "cd /config && docker compose restart"

  authentik:backup-db:
    desc: "Backup Authentik PostgreSQL database"
    cmds:
      - |
        IP=$(cd {{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/tofu/apps/authentik && tofu output -raw ip_address 2>/dev/null)
        BACKUP_FILE="authentik-backup-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S).sql"
        echo "Creating database backup..."
        ssh root@$IP "docker exec authentik-postgres pg_dump -U authentik authentik" > "{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/$BACKUP_FILE"
        echo "Backup saved to: $BACKUP_FILE"

  # ===========================================================================
  # AdGuard DNS Operations
  # ===========================================================================

  adguard:test:
    desc: "Test DNS resolution for homelab domains"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/sync/adguard-sync.sh test

  # ===========================================================================
  # IP Address Management
  # ===========================================================================

  ip:next:
    desc: "Show the next available IP address for new LXC deployment"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/ip/next.sh

  ip:list:
    desc: "Show all allocated IP addresses"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/ip/list.sh

  # ===========================================================================
  # Cleanup & Maintenance
  # ===========================================================================

  cleanup:
    desc: "Clean up temporary files, backups, and cruft (dry run)"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/cleanup.sh

  cleanup:run:
    desc: "Clean up temporary files, backups, and cruft (actually delete)"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/cleanup.sh --run

  # ===========================================================================
  # Local Development
  # ===========================================================================

  dev:dashboards:up:
    desc: "Start Homepage and Dashy locally for testing configs"
    dir: "{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/dev/dashboards"
    cmds:
      - docker compose up -d
      - |
        echo ""
        echo "=== Dashboard Dev Environment ==="
        echo ""
        echo "Homepage: http://localhost:3000"
        echo "Dashy:    http://localhost:4001"
        echo ""
        echo "Config files are mounted from tofu/apps/dashboards/deploy/"
        echo "Edit configs and refresh browser to see changes."
        echo "(Dashy may need container restart for config changes)"
        echo ""
        echo "Stop with: task dev:dashboards:down"

  dev:dashboards:down:

# Homelab Infrastructure Automation
# https://taskfile.dev

version: '3'

vars:
  PROJECT_ROOT: "{{.TASKFILE_DIR}}"
  TOFU_DIR: "{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/tofu"

env:
  # State encryption passphrase - MUST be TF_VAR because encryption runs before providers
  # All other secrets are now fetched via 1Password provider directly in OpenTofu
  TF_VAR_state_encryption_passphrase:
    sh: |
      if [ -n "$TF_VAR_state_encryption_passphrase" ]; then
        echo "$TF_VAR_state_encryption_passphrase"
      else
        op read "op://homelab/opentofu/password" 2>/dev/null || echo ""
      fi

# =============================================================================
# Included Taskfiles (flattened into main namespace)
# =============================================================================
includes:
  tofu:
    taskfile: ./tasks/tofu.yml
    flatten: true
    vars:
      PROJECT_ROOT: "{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}"
  backup:
    taskfile: ./tasks/backup.yml
    flatten: true
    vars:
      PROJECT_ROOT: "{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}"
  cloud:
    taskfile: ./tasks/cloud.yml
    flatten: true
    vars:
      PROJECT_ROOT: "{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}"
  template:
    taskfile: ./tasks/template.yml
    flatten: true
    vars:
      PROJECT_ROOT: "{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}"
  pbs:
    taskfile: ./tasks/pbs.yml
    flatten: true
    vars:
      PROJECT_ROOT: "{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}"
  importer:
    taskfile: ./tasks/immich-importer.yml
    vars:
      PROJECT_ROOT: "{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}"
  beads:
    taskfile: ./tasks/beads.yml
    flatten: true
    vars:
      PROJECT_ROOT: "{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}"

tasks:
  # ===========================================================================
  # Desktop LXC (Temporary GUI for Downloads)
  # ===========================================================================

  desktop:create:
    desc: "Create temporary GUI desktop LXC for downloading Google Takeout"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/desktop-lxc/create.sh

  desktop:destroy:
    desc: "Destroy temporary GUI desktop LXC"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/desktop-lxc/destroy.sh

  desktop:info:
    desc: "Show VNC connection info for desktop LXC"
    cmds:
      - |
        IP=$(ssh root@homelab "pct exec 600 -- ip -4 addr show eth0 | grep inet | awk '{print \$2}' | cut -d/ -f1" 2>/dev/null)
        if [ -z "$IP" ]; then
          echo "Desktop LXC (600) is not running or does not exist."
          echo "Run 'task desktop:create' first."
          exit 1
        fi
        echo "=== Desktop LXC VNC Connection ==="
        echo ""
        echo "VNC Host: $IP:5901"
        echo ""
        echo "macOS: Open Finder, Cmd+K, enter vnc://$IP:5901"
        echo ""
        echo "Downloads save to: /downloads (mounted to /tank/photo-import)"

  desktop:restart-vnc:
    desc: "Restart VNC server on desktop LXC"
    cmds:
      - |
        echo "Restarting VNC server..."
        ssh root@homelab "pct exec 600 -- bash -c 'vncserver -kill :1 2>/dev/null || true; vncserver :1 -geometry 1920x1080 -depth 24 -localhost no'"
        echo "VNC server restarted on display :1"

  # ===========================================================================
  # Authelia Operations
  # ===========================================================================

  authelia:secrets:
    desc: "Generate Authelia secrets from 1Password"
    cmds:
      - |
        SECRETS_DIR="{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/tofu/apps/authelia/deploy/secrets"
        mkdir -p "$SECRETS_DIR"
        echo "Fetching secrets from 1Password..."
        op read "op://homelab/authelia/jwt_secret" > "$SECRETS_DIR/jwt_secret"
        op read "op://homelab/authelia/session_secret" > "$SECRETS_DIR/session_secret"
        op read "op://homelab/authelia/storage_encryption_key" > "$SECRETS_DIR/storage_encryption_key"
        op read "op://homelab/authelia/oidc_hmac_secret" > "$SECRETS_DIR/oidc_hmac_secret"
        op read "op://homelab/authelia/oidc_private_key" > "$SECRETS_DIR/oidc_private_key"
        chmod 600 "$SECRETS_DIR"/*
        echo "Secrets written to $SECRETS_DIR"

  authelia:users:
    desc: "Generate Authelia users database from 1Password"
    cmds:
      - |
        USERS_FILE="{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/tofu/apps/authelia/deploy/authelia/users_database.yml"
        HASH=$(op read "op://homelab/authelia/admin_password_hash")
        if [ "$HASH" = "PLACEHOLDER_RUN_DOCKER_TO_GENERATE" ]; then
          echo "ERROR: admin_password_hash is still a placeholder."
          echo "Run: docker run --rm -it authelia/authelia:latest authelia crypto hash generate argon2"
          echo "Then update 1Password: op item edit authelia --vault=homelab 'admin_password_hash=YOUR_HASH'"
          exit 1
        fi
        echo "users:" > "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "  admin:" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "    displayname: \"Admin\"" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "    email: admin@homelab.rambtech.dev" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "    password: \"$HASH\"" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "    groups:" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "      - admins" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "      - users" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "Users database written to $USERS_FILE"

  authelia:setup:
    desc: "Full Authelia setup (secrets + users)"
    cmds:
      - task: authelia:secrets
      - task: authelia:users
      - echo "Authelia setup complete. Run 'task tofu:apply APP=authelia' to deploy."

  # ===========================================================================
  # Authentik Operations (Identity Provider - replaces Authelia)
  # ===========================================================================

  authentik:deploy:
    desc: "Deploy Authentik LXC container"
    cmds:
      - task: tofu:apply
        vars:
          APP: authentik

  authentik:status:
    desc: "Check Authentik container status"
    cmds:
      - |
        IP=$(cd {{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/tofu/apps/authentik && tofu output -raw ip_address 2>/dev/null || echo "")
        if [ -z "$IP" ]; then
          echo "Authentik not deployed yet. Run 'task authentik:deploy' first."
          exit 1
        fi
        echo "=== Authentik Status ==="
        echo ""
        echo "Container IP: $IP"
        echo ""
        echo "Checking services..."
        ssh root@$IP "cd /config && docker compose ps" 2>/dev/null || echo "Cannot connect to container"
        echo ""
        echo "URLs:"
        echo "  Admin:  https://auth.homelab.rambtech.dev/if/admin/"
        echo "  User:   https://auth.homelab.rambtech.dev/if/user/"
        echo "  Direct: http://$IP:9000"

  authentik:logs:
    desc: "View Authentik logs (server, worker, or postgres)"
    cmds:
      - |
        IP=$(cd {{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/tofu/apps/authentik && tofu output -raw ip_address 2>/dev/null)
        SERVICE="${SERVICE:-server}"
        echo "Viewing logs for authentik-$SERVICE..."
        ssh root@$IP "docker logs -f authentik-$SERVICE --tail=100"
    vars:
      SERVICE: '{{.SERVICE | default "server"}}'

  authentik:restart:
    desc: "Restart Authentik services"
    cmds:
      - |
        IP=$(cd {{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/tofu/apps/authentik && tofu output -raw ip_address 2>/dev/null)
        echo "Restarting Authentik services..."
        ssh root@$IP "cd /config && docker compose restart"

  authentik:backup-db:
    desc: "Backup Authentik PostgreSQL database"
    cmds:
      - |
        IP=$(cd {{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/tofu/apps/authentik && tofu output -raw ip_address 2>/dev/null)
        BACKUP_FILE="authentik-backup-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S).sql"
        echo "Creating database backup..."
        ssh root@$IP "docker exec authentik-postgres pg_dump -U authentik authentik" > "{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/$BACKUP_FILE"
        echo "Backup saved to: $BACKUP_FILE"

  # ===========================================================================
  # AdGuard DNS Operations
  # ===========================================================================

  adguard:test:
    desc: "Test DNS resolution for homelab domains"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/sync/adguard-sync.sh test

  # ===========================================================================
  # IP Address Management
  # ===========================================================================

  ip:next:
    desc: "Show the next available IP address for new LXC deployment"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/ip/next.sh

  ip:list:
    desc: "Show all allocated IP addresses"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/ip/list.sh

  # ===========================================================================
  # Cleanup & Maintenance
  # ===========================================================================

  cleanup:
    desc: "Clean up temporary files, backups, and cruft (dry run)"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/cleanup.sh

  cleanup:run:
    desc: "Clean up temporary files, backups, and cruft (actually delete)"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/cleanup.sh --run

  # ===========================================================================
  # Local Development
  # ===========================================================================

  dev:dashboards:up:
    desc: "Start Homepage and Dashy locally for testing configs"
    dir: "{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/dev/dashboards"
    cmds:
      - docker compose up -d
      - |
        echo ""
        echo "=== Dashboard Dev Environment ==="
        echo ""
        echo "Homepage: http://localhost:3000"
        echo "Dashy:    http://localhost:4001"
        echo ""
        echo "Config files are mounted from tofu/apps/dashboards/deploy/"
        echo "Edit configs and refresh browser to see changes."
        echo "(Dashy may need container restart for config changes)"
        echo ""
        echo "Stop with: task dev:dashboards:down"

  dev:dashboards:down:
    desc: "Stop local dashboard dev environment"
    dir: "{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/dev/dashboards"
    cmds:
      - docker compose down

  dev:dashboards:logs:
    desc: "View logs from local dashboard containers"
    dir: "{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/dev/dashboards"
    cmds:
      - docker compose logs -f {{.SERVICE}}
    vars:
      SERVICE: '{{.SERVICE | default ""}}'

  dev:dashboards:restart:
    desc: "Restart local dashboard containers (useful after config changes)"
    dir: "{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/dev/dashboards"
    cmds:
      - docker compose restart {{.SERVICE}}
      - echo "Restarted. Dashy takes ~40s to fully start."
    vars:
      SERVICE: '{{.SERVICE | default ""}}'
